title: By the Books: the flag keys
description: Every key By the Books writes under flags["fvtt-mod-bythebooks"] (and read under flags["fvtt-mod-battleflow"] on a document written before the rename), as decide/moments.js classifies it: a `record` is a resolve the moment gate publishes (`family` its word or words), a `state` key carries the reason it is state. `writers` are the scripts/ files that write it, `on` the documents a recorded run saw it on, `stamp` where the stat stamp (`combat`, `sourceUuid`; ARCHITECTURE §4 *The data plane*) sits, `readBy` the family repos whose contracts/consumes.json name it, `fields` and `schema` its recorded shape. A chat card keeps its flags forever, so a reader must tolerate every shape a key ever had; `version` moves when a field another repo reads is renamed or removed.

ac.means: an envelope field beside respondsTo — the AC the reaction produced

against.means: an ActiveEffect field — the ONE creature a use chip is against (Studied Attacks, B3); the roll at it that spends the chip (chipSpend) is the resolve

alsoHeal.means: the pick on a healing spell's card of one more creature for a feature's own heal (Starry Form's Chalice, A1) — a latch; the heal's own card and its receipt are the resolve

answer.means: an envelope field beside respondsTo — what was answered

applied.means: an ActiveEffect's fingerprint — written by the module's applier; its landing is the effect receipt's resolve

areaChoice.means: a spell that chooses its targets (Slow, Sleep — the Chosen Areas list) was told who its area affects by its caster (saves/demand.js raises the ask, metamagic.js answers it); resolved when `asked` — the default written because there was nothing to choose is no one's decision and publishes nothing

areaMove.means: the card an area's move damage posts (emanations.js, Spike Growth) — the receipt on the same card is the resolve

areaNotice.means: the card an area's ban posts as a creature moves in or out (emanations.js, Magic Circle and Forcecage) — a notice, the move never paused; presentation

areas.means: an ActiveEffect field on a concentration effect — the uuids of the regions its cast placed, the sweep's tie (emanations.js, 2026-09-19)

armed.means: an ActiveEffect field — a scoped fold armed from the sheet (the die, its skills); the fold into the check is the d20fold resolve

armorBlock.means: presentation — an actor flag riding the damage's own update: what Heavy Armor Master cut from an attack, for every client to pop "−N" over the armored creature; the damage receipt is the record (damage-rules.js, 2026-09-26)

atZero.means: on a damage card: the defender whose reduction took it to 0 used the feature's own activity at the attacker (Deflect Attacks' Redirect, A1) — a latch; the save activity's own card and the saves machine's verdict are the resolve

attackFor.means: provenance — the attack a damage roll answers (auto-damage.js)

attackHoldPending.means: the offer is waiting on a hold; the hold's answer is the resolve

auraRider.means: presentation — the aura rider's line on the usage card (Smite of Protection's members); the effect receipts on the same card are the resolve

autoCrit.means: provenance — the crit was auto-applied to the damage config

baitSwitch.means: Bait and Switch's AC bonus found its wearer — the fighter or the other creature (superiority-uses.js); resolved when `chosen` is set

bashFor.means: provenance — the driven bash's usage card names the offer it answers

bashOffer.means: Shield Master's bash offer on a melee hit, or Tavern Brawler's push on an Unarmed Strike hit (kind shove), was answered — used or passed (bash-offer.js); resolved when `status` is resolved

bashUsed.means: an actor flag — the once-per-turn stamp; bashOffer is the resolve

bent.means: an envelope field beside respondsTo — a `roll` answer's bent d20 (Slice A), carried to the fold

by.means: an envelope field beside respondsTo — the GUARD who answered a held target (Protection, 2026-09-26); the fold onto the hold flag is the resolve

bystanderMute.means: an ActiveEffect flag — the mute (Q2 option A, 2026-09-29; the scopes RULINGS *The asks widened*): the bystander feature its bearer muted, `until` its next turn or the combat's end (`combat` null: until the next combat); a player's preference, swept at the turn or with the combat, no resolve

bystanderRoll.means: a bystander bent another creature's save or check — Restore Balance, Cutting Words (bystanders.js, Q2 option A); resolved when the offer leaves pending: the bend, or everyone passed

bystanderRollAnswer.means: a message flag — a bystander's answer to another creature's save or check, relayed to the roll's keeper (bystanders.js); the envelope, the roll's `bystanderRoll` is the resolve

cardChip.means: a card chip offered on a cast's card and, once built, the chip it wrote — Tinker's Tiny Clockwork Device (use-chips.js); the build is the resolve

cardId.means: an ActiveEffect field — the card that wrote it

cardKey.means: an ActiveEffect field — which card-chip row wrote this chip (Tinker's Tiny Clockwork Device)

castApply.means: a cast's alternative effect was chosen — Fire Shield's warm or chill (cast.js); resolved when `choice.chosen` is set. The application itself is the effect receipt's resolve

castRider.means: a usage card's line — the Wild Magic Surge d20 and whether the table rolled (cast-riders.js); the table's own card is the platform's, the Tides of Chaos use the sheet's

chipSpend.means: an attack roll used a chip up — Vex, Sap, a listed effect's marker (chip-spend.js); one resolve per chip

cleaveArm.means: Cleave armed for the extra attack; that attack is a real roll with its own card

cleaveStripped.means: provenance — the armed Cleave's second attack shed its riders

clockPick.means: the offer's rider picks before the die rolls; clockRiders on the damage message is the resolve

clockRiders.means: a clock rider's damage rode a hit — Dreadful Strike, Divine Strike, Primal Strike, Divine Fury, Assassinate (clock-riders.js); one resolve per rider

coat.means: an ActiveEffect field — which coating this chip is (use-chips.js COATINGS: the Poisoner's Poison Coating)

coatHit.means: a coating was spent by a weapon hit — the chip gone, the feature's own save used at the creatures struck (use-chips.js COATINGS, 2026-09-26); resolved once spent, a miss is moot

coatUse.means: a coating was written at its use — the Poisoner's Apply Poison vetoed into the Poison Coating chip on the actor, a dose spent (use-chips.js COATINGS, 2026-09-26); on the card the use posts

combatRoster.means: the data plane's turn→actor map — stats, never a moment

command.means: Commander's Strike directed at an ally — the notice and the chip; the die riding the ally's attack (commandRide) is the resolve, and the use posted its own card

commandOf.means: an Item flag on a summoned creature's command spell — the spell whose command it is (summons.js); a marker, nothing is published

commandRide.means: Commander's Strike's die rode the ally's attack damage (command.js); the record arrives resolved on the damage message

companion.means: an ActiveEffect flag on a companion's OWNER — the message id of the summon card it names (summons.js); the effect is a marker, the card's record holds the companion

companionEnd.means: a delete option, not a flag — the elect's own removal of a companion's effect, which the owner's removal prompt lets pass (summons.js)

concentration.means: a concentration save's verdict landed (concentration.js) — and the concentration broke when it failed (publishes break beside save); resolved when `outcome` is set

concentrationAsked.means: a use option, not a flag — the caster answered the end-Concentration question before a cast that skips the usage dialog (shared.js)

concentrationExempt.means: presentation — the card for a Concentration save the ask machine did not demand (Relentless Hunter: damage never breaks Hunter's Mark; concentration.js); nothing was rolled, nothing to resolve

conditionEnd.means: a feature's offer to END a condition its bearer wears — Guarded Mind (a Psionic die), Self-Restoration (free, the turn end), Physician's Touch (the healed creature) — answered with the condition or Keep (turn-grants.js, the PHB classes B4); resolved at Keep, or when the effects are gone

conditionEndAnswer.means: an envelope — a player's answer to a condition-end offer, relayed to the GM who lands it; the fold onto the conditionEnd flag is the resolve

coverIgnored.means: an attack card's line — the cover a feat ignored (Sharpshooter, Spell Sniper); presentation, the AC it took off rode the card's own recorded targets

coverMeasured.means: an attack card's line — the cover on every attack while it is measured (the 2024 DMG's corner lines; No Cover included, a hand-set status named when it wins) and put on the recorded AC; presentation, the AC rode the card's own recorded targets (reminders.js, 2026-09-27)

crushUsed.means: an actor flag — Crusher's once-per-turn push stamp (SHOVES); bashOffer (kind shove) is the resolve

cunning.means: the Cunning Strike picks armed on the attack; sneakDamage on the damage message is the resolve

d20fold.means: a d20 fold — Bardic, Heroic, Tactical, Seeking — was spent into a test, or the offer was passed (d20-folds.js); one resolve per settled spend, one for a pass

damageCast.means: a bare damage spell's dice were rolled by the module at its targets — Heat Metal's class (damage-casts.js); on the cast's card

damageHold.means: a reduction "when you take damage" was answered before the damage landed — cast or taken (damage-holds.js: Stone's Endurance on any damage, Interception's guards, Cutting Words' die off an attack's damage); the landing is the receipt's

damageHoldAnswer.means: an envelope — a damage hold's answer; the fold onto the damageHold flag is the resolve

damageOffer.means: the offer window's own state (open, answered); the die it offers resolves as hitManeuver, clockRiders, sneakDamage

damageSaveCard.means: the save card a damage cast drove; its verdicts land on the saves flag

damageShare.means: the card a bond's share posts (damage-shares.js, Warding Bond) — the receipt on the same card is the resolve; `ended` when the caster's drop ended the bond

damageShield.means: a damage shield struck back at a melee attacker — its dice rolled on the defender's own message (damage-shields.js); arrives resolved

damageShields.means: the shield judgement's claim on the damage message (paid, judged) — a latch; damageShield on the ward's roll is the resolve

deathSaveOffer.means: the death save's side (Searing Vengeance, the PHB classes C1): a keeper offered its feature as a creature rolled a Death Saving Throw — answered use (half the maximum back, the burst landed) or pass (drop-to-one.js)

deathSaveOfferAnswer.means: an envelope — a keeper's answer to the death save's offer (Searing Vengeance); the fold onto deathSaveOffer is the resolve

deathThroes.means: the demand card a `died` row raised at the corpse (Death Throes, drop-to-one.js) — beside the saves record, which is the resolve

diceChange.means: the dice changers' one popup on a damage roll resolved (dice-changers.js, 2026-09-27) — per row used: Savage Attacker's set and Piercer's one die publish fold, Empowered Spell's picked dice publish metamagic; resolved when `status` is used

diceRise.means: presentation — a roll message's chips for dice-rise.js to draw on every client; the roll it rides is the record, never a moment

die.means: an ActiveEffect field — the die a chip carries

drain.means: on the dealing card: the creatures already drained by it (drains.js, Life Drain) — a latch; on the drain's own card, its facts (the fall, the total, a score row's die), and the effect receipt there is the resolve

dropToOne.means: a drop to 0 Hit Points turned into a drop to 1 — Relentless Endurance answered (use or pass), Death Ward automatic (answer "auto"), or a `save` row's dice (Undead Fortitude: answer "saved" / "failed", `save` the roll; "exempt" when the damage's type or crit set the row aside) (drop-to-one.js)

dropToOneAnswer.means: an envelope — a drop-to-1 answer; the fold onto the dropToOne flag is the resolve

dropToOneSave.means: provenance — the save roll a `save` row demanded of the creature it held at 1 (Undead Fortitude, drop-to-one.js); the dropToOne record on the card is the resolve

duplicatesSave.means: provenance — the attacker's save a `save` duplicate demanded inside the hold (Unbreakable Majesty, hold/continue.js); the hold's verdict is the resolve

duplicatesSeen.means: a line on the defender's side — the attacker sees through its duplicates (a status, a sense), so nothing was rolled (hold/trigger.js, Mirror Image)

effectLanded.means: an envelope field beside respondsTo — whether the reaction's effect had arrived

effectReceipt.means: an effect landed on a target with a receipt (effect-riders.js, mastery chips, the hold's reaction effect, the cast slice), or was reverted; one resolve per effect, one more per revert

emanation.means: a Region's or template's fingerprint — the aura's kind, key, source token and who stood inside at the cast

emanationCard.means: an emanation's damage type was chosen by its caster (emanations.js); resolved when `chosen` is set

emanationHeal.means: a button on the emanation's card — the heal's use posts its own card

emanationPick.means: the card a `pick` ring posts at its bearer's turn start (Wrath of the Sea, B5) — who stands inside, the one chosen (`picked`) and whether the demand went out (`demanded`); the saves record on the demand it raises is the resolve

emanationPickAnswer.means: an envelope — the caster's band side or type pick on an area's card; the fold onto emanationCard is the resolve, and the region follows it

emanationPickChoice.means: an envelope — the bearer's creature pick on the emanationPick card; the fold onto emanationPick is the resolve

emanationPulse.means: the card a pulse ring posts at its bearer's turn end (Inner Radiance, 2026-09-25) — the receipt on the same card is the resolve

emanationRemind.means: a reminder on the emanation's card — presentation

emanationTrigger.means: the demand card an emanation's region raised on a creature — beside the saves record, which is the resolve

emanationType.means: the type set on an emanation's damage roll; the choice on emanationCard is the resolve

emanationTypeAnswer.means: an envelope — the caster's type pick; the fold onto emanationCard is the resolve

empowerEffect.means: an ActiveEffect flag on the caster of a SUMMON_EMPOWERS spell — the message id of the transform card its empowered companion stands on; removing the effect asks the revert, the transform record's `ended` is the resolve (summons.js, transforms.js)

empowerEnd.means: a delete option, not a flag — the elect's own removal of the empower effect as the form ends, which asks no second revert (transforms.js, summons.js)

failDamage.means: on a usage card: the rider a hit reaction's cast carried (Beguiling Defenses, B2) — copied onto the saves flag at the stamp; the verdict and its damage receipt are the resolve

fightingStyle.means: a damage message's record — a fighting style's number that rode the roll (Great Weapon Fighting's raised dice, Thrown's and Dueling's +2, Two-Weapon's modifier): the card's line, the float, the stats' gain; and the same key on a style's FACE effect (its key, live, its line). Presentation and bookkeeping — the number rode the roll's own config (damage-rules.js, 2026-09-26)

fightingStyleTakenOver.means: an ActiveEffect flag — the pack's own ungated effect on a Fighting Style feat, switched off while the style's face carries the rule; bookkeeping, restored when the style is unlisted (damage-rules.js, 2026-09-26)

foldSpend.means: provenance — a fold's use() is the rescue's spend, so the arming hook stands aside

form.means: an ActiveEffect field — the form effect's tie to its transform record (the card, the original creature, the row); its removal ends the form

formChip.means: an ActiveEffect's fingerprint — the transformation form a clock rider reads (Celestial Revelation's Necrotic Shroud, clock-riders.js)

formEnd.means: the card a form's end posts (transforms.js) — the clock, Concentration, Incapacitated, 0 Hit Points, the Temporary Hit Points gone, or a revert; the `ended` stamp on the transform record is the resolve

formSwap.means: the Long Rest's known-form change was answered and landed — a Known Form replaced by another, open slots filled, or kept (transforms.js, issue #2); resolved when `applied`

formSwapAnswer.means: an envelope — a player's known-form answer; the fold onto the formSwap flag, landed by the elect, is the resolve

gearLight.means: a gear light's press on its receipt card (gear-lights.js) — the effectReceipt a lighting writes is the resolve; on an ActiveEffect, the light's fingerprint (its item and state)

grappleDamage.means: Unarmed Fighting's turn-start damage was answered — 1d4 to a creature the owner grapples, dealt through the feat's own damage activity, or skipped (damage-rules.js, the fighting styles 2026-09-26, ruled U1); the clock deals it to the one creature known to be held

grappleDamageAnswer.means: an envelope — a player's Unarmed Fighting answer (deal or skip); the fold onto the grappleDamage flag is the resolve

healOnHit.means: on the dealing card: the creatures whose landed damage already paid the caster (heal-on-hit.js, Vampiric Touch) — a latch; on the heal's own card, its facts, and the receipt there is the resolve

healPending.means: a heal claimed at creation for the elect to apply; the receipt is the resolve

healReroll.means: a healing die showing a 1 was rerolled and the new face stood — Healer, on a healing spell or its own Battle Medic (heal-rerolls.js, the origin feats 2026-09-25); resolved when `status` is used

healSelf.means: a card — a `self` heal-reroll row's own healing (Blessed Healer, B4) after the owner's slot-cast heal landed on another creature; the receipt on the same card is the resolve

hitManeuver.means: a pick from the hit menu rode the damage roll (hit-menu.js); the record arrives resolved on the damage message, a resolve PER PICK (a list since 2026-09-27, a pick per group; a record from before it is its one pick). A Combat Superiority die publishes maneuver; a Giant Ancestry boon (maneuver false, 2026-09-24) publishes rider

hitManeuverCard.means: the follow-up save card the hit menu drove; its effects land as effect receipts and its verdicts as saves

hitPick.means: the hit menu's pick before the die rolls; hitManeuver on the damage message is the resolve

hold.means: a held roll's reaction was answered by its target — cast or pass (hold/answer.js, hold/clock.js); one resolve per target with an answer. Parry's die publishes under maneuver too; Stone's Endurance's use does not (reduce.maneuver false, 2026-09-24)

holdSkipped.means: a hopeless hold skipped in silence — a stat, never presented

initiativeBonusDue.means: a combat flag — the Initiative bonus a `to: "allies"` grant (Tandem Footwork, B4) owes to combatants who had not rolled when it landed; cleared as each rolls, the initiativeGrant card is the resolve

initiativeGrant.means: an Initiative grant — Persistent Rage's uses back (automatic), or Uncanny Metabolism's offer answered (the PHB classes, A6, initiative-grants.js); resolved at No, or when the sheet is written

initiativeGrantAnswer.means: an envelope — a player's answer to an Initiative grant's offer; the fold onto the initiativeGrant flag, landed by the GM, is the resolve

initiativeGrantRead.means: a combat flag — the once-per-combat latch of which combatants' Initiative grants were read; initiativeGrant on the card is the resolve

initiativeSwap.means: an Initiative swap was answered — Alert's pick of an ally, swapped in the tracker by the elect, or no swap (initiative-swap.js, the origin feats 2026-09-25); resolved at No, or when the swap is applied

initiativeSwapAnswer.means: an envelope — a player's Initiative swap answer; the fold onto the initiativeSwap flag, landed by the elect, is the resolve

initiativeSwapAsked.means: a combat flag — the once-per-combat latch of who was asked about an Initiative swap; initiativeSwap on the card is the resolve

kitTend.means: a kit's tending was answered — Healer's Battle Medic: the tended creature's Hit Point Die spent and the feature's own heal of that size rolled at it by the elect, or not used (kit-tend.js, the origin-feat walk 2026-09-25); resolved at a Pass, or when the tending is applied

kitTendAnswer.means: an envelope — a player's kit-tending answer; the fold onto the kitTend flag, landed by the elect, is the resolve

kitTendFor.means: a back-link — the heal a kit's tending drove, pointing at the kit's card; the kitTend flag there is the resolve

knownForms.means: an Item field — the Known Forms a Wild Shape item holds (uuid, name, art); the transform record (a form learned at the use) and the formSwap record (the Long Rest's change) are the resolves

lastForm.means: an Item field — the form last taken through the item (transforms.js; a summon spell's profile, summons.js), marked on its row at the next use; presentation

leadWindow.means: a User flag on a GM — the id of the window that leads when the game is open in two (core.js leadsWindow); claimed on load and focus, cleared on close

lightOn.means: a use option, not a flag — where the summon menu put a light spell (token or object), read by summons.js and token-lights.js at the use

lungePick.means: Lunging Attack's tick on the offer; superiorityRide is the resolve

mastery.means: a weapon mastery's ask was answered and executed — used or passed (mastery.js); resolved when `status` is done. On an ActiveEffect the same key is the chip's fingerprint, which no message carries

masteryFill.means: the GM's whisper — which kinds the fill wrote into the sheet's mastery list and for whom (issue #3); the sheet's list is the state, the attack the system stamps is the resolve

masteryPick.means: Tactical Master's pick at the hit — which mastery the wielder chose (or passed) before the machine resolved it (mastery.js); resolved when `status` is done

masterySwap.means: the long-rest mastery swap was answered and landed — one chosen weapon kind replaced by another on the sheet's own list, or kept (mastery-record.js, issue #3); resolved when `applied`

masterySwapAnswer.means: an envelope — a player's swap answer; the fold onto the masterySwap flag, landed by the elect, is the resolve

mealFed.means: an ACTOR flag — a Chef's meal an eater still resting carries to its own rest's end (the PHB feats, group 5); the meal's card is the record, the restSong flag the resolve

metamagic.means: a Metamagic option was applied to the cast and its points spent (metamagic.js); resolved when `spent` is set on the spell's card

metamagicAsk.means: the ask at the area pending on the card (area-ask.js; the key is historical); the answer's records — the metamagic record, areaChoice, the demand — are the resolves

metamagicDeferred.means: the held card's data while Careful asks; the real card's records are the resolves

metamagicFree.means: a free class-feature tick in the casting window (Psychic Spells) - no spend, no answer; the damage roll's type is the result

metamagicType.means: the type Transmuted Spell set on the damage roll; the metamagic record on the card is the resolve

migratedFrom.means: provenance on a RegionBehavior the migration recreated under the new scope (decide/migrate.js): the id of the behaviour it replaced, so a retried load never creates a second

mishap.means: provenance — on a dark gift's save card (mishaps.js): the D20 Test whose 1 raised it; the save's verdict is the saves machine's

momentAck.means: an envelope — a notice acknowledged; presentation, not a moment

notApplied.means: a damage card's line — dice rolled on an attack every judged target was missed on (a Portent face, a Shield, a plain miss): nothing applied, the card says why (auto-apply.js, receipts.js); presentation of the attack's resolve

opportunity.means: provenance — the driven attack is an Opportunity Attack (Sentinel's Guardian, the PHB feats group 6); the Halt rider reads it, the clockRiders record is the resolve

option.means: an ITEM flag — the option a feature's character took, which the sheet never records (Hunter's Prey, A1): asked once on the damage offer, cleared by the card's Change; the clockRiders record and the hewNotice card are the moments

petNames.means: an Actor field on a caster — the name it last gave its companion of each COMPANIONS `names` spell (summons.js), the next summon menu's name field pre-filled with it; the summon record's landing is the resolve

poleStrike.means: provenance — the driven Pole Strike swing names the offer it answers (2026-09-27); the attack's own card is the record

poleStrikeDie.means: a damage card's line — Pole Strike's d4 Bludgeoning in place of the weapon's die; presentation, the receipt is the resolve

poolSpend.means: a pool was spent by hand — Sorcery Points, a rider's uses, a Seeking Spell (the uniform record shared.js poolSpendsOn reads); one resolve per record

precision.means: Precision Attack's offer on a missed attack was answered — the die spent or passed (precision.js); resolved when `status` is resolved

prismatic.means: the ray table's claim on the cast's card (prismatic.js): pending until the cone stands, rolled once — the rays' demand cards are the moments

prismaticRay.means: one ray's demand card (prismatic.js) — beside the saves record, which is the resolve; `settled` and `says` what a condition ray's verdict landed (the effectReceipt there carries it)

prismaticRays.means: the summary card of a ray table's roll — a d8 per creature, presentation; the rays' demand cards are the moments

protectedBy.means: an ActiveEffect flag — the guard whose Protection landed "Protected — <guard>" on the creature it protected (2026-09-26); provenance, the hold is the resolve

reactionEffect.means: an ActiveEffect's fingerprint — the reaction's own effect on the reactor; its landing is the effect receipt's resolve

rebuke.means: a rebuke's offer — a Reaction to taking damage, aimed at its dealer — was answered, used or passed (rebukes.js); one resolve per offer

rebukeAnswer.means: an envelope — a rebuke's answer; the fold onto the rebuke flag is the resolve

rebukeFor.means: provenance — a rebuke's driven use or attack names the offer it answers

receipt.means: damage landed on a target with a receipt (auto-apply.js), or a receipt was reverted (receipts.js); one resolve per target, one more per revert

recoiled.means: an ActiveEffect field — which attacker the Majestic Presence has already turned aside this turn, by combat turn (Unbreakable Majesty's once per turn per attacker)

reduceBy.means: an envelope field beside respondsTo — Parry's roll, carried to the fold

reminder.means: a gate's reminder record — presentation before the roll

repeatCount.means: an ActiveEffect field — a counted repeat's tally and lock (Contagion, Flesh to Stone)

repeatOffer.means: a notice at the bearer's turn start — its own action can repeat the save (Otto's Irresistible Dance); the button raises the demand card

repeatSave.means: the demand card a landed effect's repeated save raised (repeat-saves.js) — beside the saves record, which is the resolve; `settled` and `says` what the verdict did to the effect (the cast card's effectReceipt carries the removal)

rerollUsed.means: an ActiveEffect flag on the RAGE effect — the `reroll` folds spent this Rage (Fanatical Focus, B1); gone with the Rage, the spend itself is the d20fold resolve

rescue.means: an envelope field beside respondsTo — which `roll` row bent the roll (Slice A), carried to the fold

respondsTo.means: an envelope — the card this message answers; the fold onto that card is the resolve

restBlock.means: a rest card's block line (rest-grants.js, Cursed Touch) — presentation; the rest's emptied update rode the rest's own

restEnded.means: a rest card's line — what the rest ended on the rester (rest-grants.js); the deletions are the system's own, nothing is published

restGrant.means: a rest card's grant line — presentation; the sheet write rode the rest's own update

restSong.means: a rest grant GIVEN to allies was answered and landed — Musician's Encouraging Song, Heroic Inspiration to the picked allies (rest-grants.js); resolved when `applied`

restSongAnswer.means: an envelope — a player's picks for a rest song; the fold onto the restSong flag, landed by the elect, is the resolve

restSpent.means: a Short Rest card's Hit Dice spent (the PHB feats, group 5) — a fact the Chef's meal reads; the restSong flag is the resolve

riderKey.means: an ActiveEffect field — which rider's turn chit this is

riderSave.means: provenance on a usage card — a DMG weapon rider's save (clock-riders.js `save`): the save alone, no damage rolled; the saves verdict is the resolve

riposte.means: Riposte's offer on an enemy's miss was answered by each reactor — strike back or decline (riposte.js); one resolve per reactor with an answer

riposteAnswer.means: an envelope — a reactor's answer; the fold onto the riposte flag is the resolve

riposteBy.means: provenance — the driven attack names the reactor

riposteFor.means: provenance — the driven attack names the riposte it answers

riposteUse.means: provenance — the maneuver's use names the riposte it answers

rollCtx.means: the data plane's roll context stamp — stats, never a moment

saveAutoFail.means: the Fails press on the roll message; the verdict on the saves flag is the resolve

saveChoiceAnswer.means: an envelope — a save-side choice; the fold onto the saves flag is the resolve

saveFor.means: an envelope field beside respondsTo — the saves channel's target uuid

saves.means: a demanded save's verdict landed for a target (saves/verdict.js) — rolled, timed out or auto-failed; one resolve per target done, and one per save-side choice answered (publishes choice)

savesDeferredRoll.means: the caster's deferred damage roll while the saves are pending; the verdicts are the resolve

shield.means: an ActiveEffect's fingerprint — the standing ward; shieldMark is its raising and damageShield its strike

shieldEnded.means: a notice — Armor of Agathys ended with its pool; presentation

shieldMark.means: a damage shield was raised at the cast — the ward's effect on its bearer (damage-shields.js); on the cast's card

shoveUsed.means: an actor flag — Tavern Brawler's once-per-turn stamp; bashOffer (kind shove) is the resolve

sneak.means: the Sneak Attack arm on the attack (and rolled:true after); sneakDamage is the resolve

sneakDamage.means: Sneak Attack's dice rode the damage roll with the Cunning Strike picks (sneak.js); the record arrives resolved on the damage message

sourceName.means: an ActiveEffect field — who wrote it, by name

sourceUuid.means: an ActiveEffect field (and every record's stat stamp) — who wrote it

spellDamage.means: a no-attack damage card claimed at birth for the elect's applier (polish.js, hold/spell-damage.js); the receipt is the resolve

spellHoldPending.means: the spell's damage is waiting on a hold; the hold's answer is the resolve

spellRider.means: the caster's pick of the ONE target a spell's extra damage goes to, on the spell's damage card; spellRiderCard is the resolve

spellRiderCard.means: a transformation's extra damage rode a SPELL's damage onto the one target its caster picked — Celestial Revelation (clock-riders.js, the Aasimar walk 2026-09-25); the receipt on the same card is the damage's own resolve

spend.means: a use's own resource movement was stamped for the flash — item uses, activity uses, spell slots (resources.js); on the usage card

stacks.means: an ActiveEffect field — a deliberate stack, one chip per device; the twin-chip dedupe leaves it alone (effect-riders.js)

storedAsk.means: a rest card's ask — the stored dice the bearer owes a roll for (Portent: the player rolls them, 2026-10-14); the roll message (storedFor) is the record

storedDice.means: an effect field — a STORED_DICE chip's faces and the turn one was spent (Portent); the bent roll's record (hold, bystanderRoll) or the roll itself is the resolve

storedFor.means: a back-link — the roll message the rest's stored dice landed on, pointing at the rest card; the storedAsk flag there is the ask

storedRolled.means: a roll message's line — the stored dice the rest's roll kept (Portent); the chip on the bearer is the state

storedUsed.means: a roll message's line — the stored face that replaced its d20 (Portent); the roll is the record

summon.means: a summon the module drove was landed by the elect — the creature(s) created from the caster's placement, the spell's own choice applied, ownership granted (summons.js, issue #1); resolved when `applied`; a companion's later beats (into the pocket, called back, dismissed) each resolve on their own marker, `details.companion` leave or appear

summonCard.means: a token flag on a landed summon and an ActiveEffect flag on its caster's shared resistance — the message id of the summon card; a landing re-driven after its claimant left removes what carries it first, the card's record is the resolve (summons.js)

summonEffect.means: an ActiveEffect flag on the caster of a summon without Concentration — the message id of the summon card; removing the effect asks the dismissal, the card's record is the resolve (summons.js)

summonEnd.means: a delete option, not a flag — the elect's own removal of a summon's standing effect, which asks no second dismissal (summons.js)

superiorityRide.means: a Bonus Action maneuver's die (Lunging Attack, Feinting Attack) rode a later hit (superiority-uses.js); one resolve per die

superiorityUse.means: a Bonus Action maneuver's use landed its consequence — a rolled bonus, a chip, a marker (superiority-uses.js); on the use's own card

sweepAnswer.means: an envelope — the sweep's pick; the fold onto sweepCard is the resolve

sweepCard.means: Sweeping Attack's second creature was picked and the die rolled at it (hit-menu.js); resolved when `resolved` is set

swingNoticed.means: the attack-trigger bonus swing's dedupe (Pole Strike, 2026-09-27) — the hewNotice card is the moment

tacticalArmed.means: Tactical Assessment or Ambush armed from the sheet (its own card); the fold into the check is the d20fold resolve

tacticalRefund.means: Tactical Mind's refund was asked and answered — kept or refunded (d20-folds.js); resolved when `status` leaves pending

timedOut.means: the buzzer's mark on a roll it made; the verdict it lands is the resolve

tokenLight.means: a token light's payload on the use's card and what landed (token-lights.js) — the effectReceipt it writes is the resolve; on an ActiveEffect, the light's fingerprint

topple.means: a Topple save's verdict landed for a target — saved, prone, or failed before the dice (topple.js); one resolve per target done

transform.means: a transform the module drove was landed by the elect — the creature(s) turned into the picked form with dnd5e's own transformInto, a learned Known Form written, the form effect clocked (transforms.js, issue #2); a feature publishes use, a spell cast; resolved when `applied`

turnGrant.means: the card a turn-start grant posts (turn-grants.js, Heroism's temp HP; Regeneration's heal on the bearer's own trait) — the receipt on the same card is the resolve; a `blocked` card (the troll's fire) carries no receipt and resolves nothing; a `grant: "inspiration"` card (Heroic Warrior, B4) records the sheet's own write, no receipt

twistFor.means: provenance — the driven save (Beguiling Twist, B2) names the bystander roll it answers

typePick.means: a typed feat's damage type was chosen as it landed — Elemental Adept's copy renamed "Elemental Adept (Fire)" (damage-rules.js, the PHB feats walk 2026-09-26); resolved when a type is chosen, at the popup or by a rename

unarmedDice.means: a damage card's line — Tavern Brawler's die rolled in place of the flat Unarmed Strike; presentation, the formula rode the roll's own config

useChip.means: a use-chip was written at a feature's use — Steady Aim and its class (use-chips.js); on the use's own card

useKey.means: an ActiveEffect field — which use-chip this is

uuid.means: an envelope field beside respondsTo — which target answered

volley.means: a volley's darts or rays were assigned and fired (volleys.js); resolved when `status` is resolved

volleyDarts.means: provenance — a volley's roll names its dart count

volleyFor.means: provenance — a volley's roll names its card

volleyRay.means: provenance — a volley's roll names its ray

volleyTarget.means: provenance — a volley's roll names its target

ward.means: the demand card a ward raised of whoever targeted its bearer (wards.js, Sanctuary) — beside the saves record, which is the resolve; `settled`, `outcome` and `says` whether the use went on or was turned aside

wardAbsorb.means: an actor field — the ward's take on its bearer's damage update, for the pop on every client; the receipt is the resolve

wardEnded.means: the card a ward's end posts (wards.js) — its bearer's own attack roll, cast or damage roll ended it; the effect's deletion is the act

wardPool.means: an ActiveEffect flag on the WARDED creature — an effect ward's hit points (Bastion of Law, B4: `{ feature, left, max }`), lowered as damage lands, the effect gone at 0; the wardAbsorb record on the bearer's update is the resolve

wardRefill.means: a usage card's line — the ward created or refilled by an Abjuration cast; the item's uses are the state

weaponRolls.means: provenance — how many of an attack's damage rolls are the activity's own, counted before any rider (auto-damage.js); Savage Attacker rerolls those
